statement.zh: 乌尔除塔庙外的乌尔第三王朝建筑——含已刊敦吉/布尔辛陵、城墙与乌尔纳姆石碑语境——见 Woolley UE VI（1974）。
statement.en: At Ur, Ur III buildings other than the ziggurat—including Dungi/Bur-Sin mausolea, city wall, and the Stela of Ur-Nammu contexts as published—are documented in Woolley UE VI (1974).
